BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: What does the Iron Curtain refer to? ASSISTANT:
The Iron Curtain was a figurative name for the political boundary between Eastern and Western Europe during the Cold War, which was symbolized by the physical barrier of the Berlin Wall.
